title: RPC transport layer (server, client, codec, error mapping)
description:
Implement the full RPC transport layer for AgentService: error mapping, wire-format
codec, AgentRPCServer, transport.Server refactoring, and AgentServiceClient.

Sections: 5 (RPC Transport), 5.1 (ConnectRPC Procedures), 5.2 (AgentRPCServer),
5.3 (AgentServiceClient), 5.4 (Error Mapping), 5.5 second half (wire-format codec)

Key deliverables:
- internal/rpc/errors.go — Extend MapError() with agent error -> ConnectRPC code mappings
  (BusyError, StoppedError, InvalidStateError, ErrQueueFull, session not found, etc.)
- internal/rpc/codec/agent_map.go — Wire-format codec: SessionMetrics serialization,
  EventReceiver -> AgentEventReceiver adaptation, ResourceSpec mapping, request/response
  serialization + unit tests (agent_map_test.go)
- internal/rpc/server/agent_server.go — AgentRPCServer with handlers for all 11 procedures
  (8 unary + 3 server-stream). Follows SandboxServer delegation pattern.
- internal/rpc/transport/server.go — REFACTOR to functional options (WithSandboxService,
  WithAgentEventService, WithSessionManager, WithAgentService). Handler() conditionally
  registers procedures. Update existing sandbox-host callers. This is a change to plan 13.
- internal/rpc/client/agent_client.go — AgentServiceClient implementing AgentService over
  ConnectRPC. Server stream methods return EventReceiver wrapping ConnectRPC stream.
- Unit tests for error mapping, codec round-trips, server handler delegation, client construction

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc.md §5, §5.1-§5.5
- Test harness: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc-test-harness.md §6 (RT1-RT3)
- Depends on: aiag-rmv.2 (AgentLoopService)
